announcements.title: Update to StegZ 2.4.1
announcements.message:
A new StegZ (version 2.4.1) is ready, with a faster app, more tools and fixes.

If Android says "App not installed" or refuses to update, do this once:
1. Press and hold the StegZ icon, then tap Uninstall.
2. Download StegZ again from the website and install it.

Your hidden pictures and saved files are NOT lost - they are stored in your phone's folders (like Downloads/StegZ), not inside the app. Only the app's small settings reset.

After this one-time step, every future update installs normally on top.

announcements.title: StegZ 1.5 for Windows
announcements.message:
• Right-click Extract here / Extract to <archive name> now shows a progress window instantly and works in the background
• Zip files unpack on several processor cores, with real progress
• New Search (Ctrl+F), Biggest files, Properties with SHA-256
• New Power Tools: duplicate finder, bulk rename, hidden-data scanner, checksums, split & join, password generator, cleanup
• Shred files and remove GPS/camera data from photos
Tip: the Help button explains everything.

announcements.title: StegZ 2.4 for Android
announcements.message:
• Installed apps: extract APKs (even split apps), open, uninstall
• APK info and install: package, version, permissions, signature
• Shred files and remove photo data (GPS, camera) for real privacy
• Search inside text and code files
Made by Havenova X
